description:
Activate Titanbones by using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Titanbones triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

uses.name: Titanbones, Towering Heart
uses.cardState: with a +1/+1 counter on it and has lifelink
